items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: Gene really knows what he's doing. He's Les Paul's kid. He grew up in the house where most of this was invented.

ctx.x: But you took out a verse or —
I don’t even remember what it was. But I shortened it. You know, I always work with good engineers. So you know, you’ve been there when we do our magic, with Gene, I work with Gene [Paul] you know.
